about: Viewer questions for the analyst check. Gold answers come from the base 2.0.77 prototype dump (kb.py), the curated notes (space-age, biters-pollution), and for 'state' questions the shake2 score log at game minute 50 (snapshot 0h48m) with shake2 excluded from history. An answer is right when every group in 'check' matches (case-insensitive regex) and no 'reject' pattern does.

questions.q: What goes into green science?
questions.gold: 1 inserter + 1 transport belt makes 1 logistic (green) science pack in 6 s.

questions.q: How many assembling machine 2s do you need for 60 green science per minute?
questions.gold: 8 (6 s per pack at crafting speed 0.75).

questions.q: If the labs switch to a different research, is the progress on the old one lost?
questions.gold: No. Progress is kept and resumes when the tech is picked again.
check: kept|saved|not lost|never lost|isn't lost|is not lost|retain|keeps?\b|stays|preserved|no,? (it'?s|it is)? ?not

questions.q: How do you unlock oil processing in Factorio 2.0?
questions.gold: It is a trigger technology: after oil gathering (pumpjack), mining crude oil completes it; no science packs.

questions.q: How much power does one steam engine make?
How many steam engines can one boiler run?
questions.gold: 2 (boiler 1.8 MW, engine 0.9 MW).

questions.q: How many boilers can one offshore pump supply?
questions.gold: 20 (1,200 water per second; each boiler uses 60).

questions.q: What does a rocket part cost?
questions.gold: 10 processing units, 10 low density structures and 10 rocket fuel, made in the silo; a rocket needs 100 parts.

questions.q: Why do biters attack the base?
questions.gold: Pollution spreads across chunks; when it reaches nests (spawners) they absorb it and send attack groups at the polluters.

questions.q: At what evolution do medium biters start to appear?
questions.gold: From evolution 0.2 (20%).

questions.q: What is the range of a gun turret?
questions.gold: 18 tiles.

questions.q: How fast is a yellow transport belt?
questions.gold: 15 items per second (900 per minute), both lanes.

questions.q: From a new game, how many technologies do you need to research to get the rocket silo?
questions.gold: 44 including the rocket silo itself (43 before it).

questions.q: What is blue science made of?
questions.gold: 1 sulfur, 3 advanced circuits and 2 engine units make 2 chemical science packs in 24 s.

questions.q: How much ore does an electric mining drill mine per minute?
questions.gold: 30 per minute (0.5 per second) on iron, copper, coal or stone, before mining productivity.

questions.q: How much pollution does a boiler make per minute?
questions.gold: 30 per minute.

questions.q: What does steel processing unlock, and what does it cost?
questions.gold: Steel plate and steel chest; 50 red science (50 units of 5 s).

questions.q: How long does an iron plate take to smelt in a stone furnace?
questions.gold: 3.2 seconds (stone furnace speed 1).

questions.q: How many stone furnaces make 120 iron plates per minute?
questions.gold: 6.4, so 7 furnaces.

questions.q: How long does oil gathering take to research with 9 labs?
questions.gold: About 5.6 minutes (100 units x 30 s / 9 labs), if red and green packs keep up (about 18 of each per minute).
check: 5\.[5-7]|about 6|six minutes|6 minutes|five and a half|5 and a half|under 6

questions.q: Which planets are in Space Age?
questions.gold: Nauvis plus Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba and Aquilo (and the solar system edge / Shattered Planet beyond).

questions.q: What is the Shattered Planet?
questions.gold: A destroyed planet far beyond the solar system edge; you cannot land; its remains are promethium asteroids, used for promethium science.

questions.q: What is the team researching right now?
questions.gold: Engine.

questions.q: What is the team's science per minute right now?
questions.gold: About 24.5 (16.3 red + 8.2 green) over the last 10 minutes.

questions.q: How does this team's pace compare with shake1 at the same point?
questions.gold: Behind on output: 24.5 SPM vs shake1's 30.6 at minute 50; ahead on research, 13 technologies vs 11.

questions.q: What is the next big milestone, and when does it usually come?
questions.gold: Oil: engine, fluid handling, oil gathering, then oil processing by mining crude; past runs got oil processing at minutes 54 to 61, the nine-agent runs never did.

questions.q: Is copper or iron the bottleneck right now?
questions.gold: Copper: about 66 copper plates per minute against 294 iron.

questions.q: How many assembling machine 1s do you need for 60 red science per minute?
questions.gold: 10 (5 s per pack at crafting speed 0.5).

questions.q: Can a biter attack destroy research progress?
questions.gold: No. Biters can destroy labs, which pauses research, but finished techs and saved progress stay.

questions.q: The overlay says '7 lost near the iron mines: 4 stone wall, 3 gun turret (by 5 small biter)'. What happened?
questions.gold: Our own 4 walls and 3 gun turrets were destroyed by small biters (5 were involved); it is a loss for the team, not new enemies or nests.
